in_marathi.name: Advay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Unique, One, Unity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Advay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Advay means 'one without a second'. It represents the concept of unity and oneness. It is often used in philosophical and spiritual contexts to signify the ultimate reality or the absolute truth.
